title: Hearty Charred Ukrainian Yukon Gold Potatoes Gratin
description: A flavorful and nutritious Ukrainian-inspired dish featuring charred Yukon Gold potatoes, a creamy pasta-water emulsion, and a hint of smokiness from the Robata grill. This hearty gratin is perfect for meal prep and is low in fat.
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1-inch wedges and place them in a large bowl.
In a small saucepan, heat the pasta water emulsion over low heat.
In a separate saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the flour to the saucepan and whisk until smooth, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the pasta water emulsion, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it thickens.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the saucepan and stir until melted.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the potato wedges in a single layer in a shallow baking dish.
Pour the sauce over the potatoes and top with additional grated cheese if desired.
Transfer the dish to the preheated Robata grill and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove the dish from the grill and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Use a spatula to loosen the potatoes from the baking dish and serve hot.
